title: Vocabulary used in Probability
author: 656abce5a94ca87cb6cfb275
chapter_outcomes: Sample space. Exclusive and complementary events. Conditional probability. Understanding and use of P(A′) = 1 − P(A), P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B), P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B |A).
Independence of two events. P(B | A) = P(B), P(A | B) = P(A), P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B).
Sum and product laws. Use of tree diagrams and Venn diagrams. Sampling with and without replacement.
